        self.handref=[self.d.site('left_hand').xpos.copy(),self.d.site('right_hand').xpos.copy()]
        self.prev=None

        jp=np.zeros((3,self.m.nv));jr=jp.copy();mujoco.mj_jacSite(self.m,d,jp,jr,self.m.site(name).id)

        m,d=self.m,self.d;n=25
        if com is None:com=self.com
        if hands is None:hands=self.handref
        if footpos is None:footpos=self.feet
        if footyaw is None:footyaw=[0,0]
        t=self.tmp;t.qpos[:]=d.qpos;t.qvel[:]=d.qvel
        eps=1e-5;mujoco.mj_integratePos(m,t.qpos,t.qvel,eps);mujoco.mj_forward(m,t)
        v=d.qvel[:n]
        As=[];bs=[]
        def add(J,J1,error,kp=70,kd=18,w=1):
            acc=kp*np.asarray(error)-kd*(J@v)-(J1-J)@v/eps
            As.append(np.pad(J,((0,0),(0,12)))*w);bs.append(acc*w)
        Jcs=[];cacc=[]
        for k,site in enumerate(['left_foot','right_foot']):
            J,R=self.jac(d,site);J1,R1=self.jac(t,site)
            rot=d.site(site).xmat.reshape(3,3)
            want=Rotation.from_euler('z',footyaw[k]).as_matrix()
            er=Rotation.from_matrix(want@rot.T).as_rotvec()
            Jc=np.concatenate([J,R]);Jc1=np.concatenate([J1,R1]);err=np.r_[footpos[k]-d.site(site).xpos,er]
            acc=100*err-20*(Jc@v)-(Jc1-Jc)@v/eps

        Jc=np.concatenate(Jcs);cacc=np.concatenate(cacc)
        J=np.zeros((3,m.nv));J1=J.copy();mujoco.mj_jacSubtreeCom(m,d,J,1);mujoco.mj_jacSubtreeCom(m,t,J1,1)
        add(J[:,:n],J1[:,:n],np.array(com)-d.subtree_com[1],70,18,4)

        J=np.zeros((3,m.nv));R=J.copy();J1=J.copy();R1=J.copy()
        mujoco.mj_jacBody(m,d,J,R,12);mujoco.mj_jacBody(m,t,J1,R1,12)
        want=Rotation.from_euler('z',yaw).as_matrix();er=Rotation.from_matrix(want@d.xmat[12].reshape(3,3).T).as_rotvec()
        add(R[:,:n],R1[:,:n],er,70,18,3)
        for k,site in enumerate(['left_hand','right_hand']):

        A=np.concatenate(As);b=np.concatenate(bs)
        E=np.r_[np.c_[M[:6],-Jc[:,:6].T],np.c_[Jc,np.zeros((12,12))]]

def qp(H,g,E,f,G,h):
    # Goldfarb-like working set: equalities plus violated active bounds.
    cf=cho_factor(H,check_finite=False)

    norm=np.maximum(np.linalg.norm(G,axis=1),1e-9)
    G=G/norm[:,None];h=h/norm
    V=np.r_[E,G];v=np.r_[f,h]

    S=V@B

    for it in range(80):

        lam=solve(mat+np.eye(len(active))*1e-9,V[active]@z-v[active],assume_a='sym',check_finite=False)
